actions.description:
Toxic materials and churning rubbish within the filth fire's body explode in one of three ways. The filth fire chooses the effect, but it can't make the same choice twice in a row.

  • Fiery Beam (evocation, fire, primal) The filth fire expels a @Template[line|distance:30] of flame that deals @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|traits:evocation,fire,primal|overrideTraits:true] save.
  • Shrapnel Blast (evocation, primal) The filth fire shoots jagged rubbish out in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that deals @Damage[2d12[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:21|basic|traits:evocation,primal|overrideTraits:true] save.
  • Toxic Fumes (evocation, poison, primal) The filth fire belches a @Template[cone|distance:15] of toxic smoke that deals @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:21|basic|traits:evocation,poison,primal|overrideTraits:true] save). A creature that fails is also Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).
actions.name: Noxious Burst

actions.description: The filth fire ignores the Concealed condition from smoke.
actions.name: Smoke Vision

name: Filth Fire
publicNotes: These creatures look like roiling clouds of black smoke churning above a mound of burning refuse. Leering faces form and fade in the smoke above, while the burning trash writhes in spasmodic lurches, obviously alive.
